highlights: Breathtaking views of the Kanchenjunga range
Protected area for flora and fauna
spots.history: Tiger Hill is a famous spot for watching the sunrise over the Himalayas. It is located at an elevation of 2590 meters and offers breathtaking views of the Kanchenjunga range. The hill is also home to the Senchal Wildlife Sanctuary, which is a protected area for various flora and fauna. The spot has been a popular tourist destination for decades, attracting visitors from all over the world. The best time to visit Tiger Hill is during the early morning hours, when the sun rises over the mountains.
spots.name: Tiger Hill

spots.reachabilityNote: Tiger Hill is reachable by private car, and there is a parking area near the viewpoint.

spots.history: The Batasia Loop is a spiral railway loop located in the Darjeeling Himalayan hill region. It is a marvel of engineering and was built in 1919. The loop is 1.5 kilometers long and has a gradient of 1 in 49. The Batasia Loop is a popular tourist destination and offers breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and valleys.

spots.history: The Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park is a zoo located in Darjeeling, West Bengal. It was established in 1958 and is home to a wide range of flora and fauna, including the red panda, snow leopard, and Himalayan black bear. The zoo is also a breeding center for the red panda and snow leopard.

spots.history: Darjeeling Town is a popular tourist destination located in the Darjeeling Himalayan hill region.
